scope: Exploratory integration cases from an external toolkit's public visualization sample; not a preregistered model comparison or adoption evidence

gsm8k.meaning: Sensitivity over declared answer extraction and numeric judgment policies; not all policies are scientifically interchangeable

ifeval.meaning: Audit externally recorded binary prompt scores; do not claim to independently rerun IFEval instruction graders

alignment: Strict equality of nonempty sample-ID sets; reorder by ID; equal target, input message content and sample metadata; fail rather than truncate or repair
gates: Reject malformed JSON, duplicate IDs, missing predictions, inconsistent model records and out-of-range scores
Check cached scoring against raw scoring and numeric cases against the independent reference implementation
Recompute every reported score-table margin using exact rational arithmetic
Preserve original source bytes and record hashes and attribution
Report ties, stable results and negative results without selecting positive cases

excluded.gpqa: The inspected upstream prediction file has malformed JSONL and the dataset card requests that examples not be published online; not redistributed or used for conclusions

limits: Ten-item public demonstration samples are not representative evaluations
Model aliases and archived outputs do not identify immutable model weights
Candidate-derived review intervals are uncalibrated assumptions
External-origin inputs are not external adoption of robustband
